RUBRIC.face: 头像可用要求头部明确，五官及轮廓连贯。明显错位或断裂记 distorted。
RUBRIC.iris: 至少一只应睁开可见的眼睛有独立虹膜，能与眼皮、肤色及阴影分开。
RUBRIC.head_contour: 头部及下颌轮廓可追踪且没有无法解释的断裂记 clear。
RUBRIC.face_clarity: 可见五官的位置与边缘清楚记 clear；自然遮挡按可见部分判断。
RUBRIC.image_quality: good 为清楚完整，acceptable 为主体完整且有轻微伪影，poor 有明显生成伪影。
RUBRIC.eye_fragmentation: 可见眼皮、眼球或眼眶出现断裂、重复、错位或与旁物粘连。
RUBRIC.nose_mouth_missing: 无遮挡面部的鼻口无法定位、熔化或移位。正常动漫简笔鼻不算缺陷。
RUBRIC.contour_fusion: 脸颊或下颌与头发、衣服或背景不合理融为一体。
RUBRIC.uncertainty: 自然遮挡、侧脸、裁切和正常画风本身不算缺陷，证据不足时记 uncertain。
RUBRIC.cfg0: CFG 0 为无条件生成。文本属性不评分，虹膜按实际可见睁眼判断，双眼自然闭合可记不适用。
RUBRIC.preferred: 选择同题中最适合做头像的列，可同时选择并列最佳；六列无明确差异时全选。

grading.assignment: three primary reviewers receive disjoint cards, every card includes all six anonymous columns
grading.root_audit_selection: within each CFG/solver condition, sort opaque card ids and independently review the first two cards; total16
grading.audit_resolution: resolve disagreements from anonymous images, preserve original shard scores and audit notes; lock final scores before reading assignment mapping

reporting.cfg0_iris_reporting: report readable/16 and applicable/16 coverage as well as readable/applicable
reporting.statistical_scope: one training seed and one initial noise seed on sixteen reused development prompts; no independent208-question result claimed
